name: L.E.K. Consulting
one_liner: Independent global strategy firm known for private equity due diligence, life sciences, and short, analytically heavy projects.
at_a_glance: Founded over 40 years ago in London; independent strategy consultancy.
Known for private equity, life sciences, and M&A work.

rounds: First round: ~2 case interviews with fit.
Final round: ~2 case interviews plus, often, a written case presentation.
interview_process.case_style: Candidate-led, quantitatively heavy strategy cases. The written case gives a slide pack to analyze in about an hour, then present and take questions.
interview_process.fit_style: Behavioral questions within case interviews, focused on motivation, teamwork, and how you handle pressure.
interview_process.assessments: None standard as far as public sources show.

what_they_look_for: Using data to reach and defend conclusions
Curiosity and asking for the information you need
Willingness to rethink with new data
culture: Described as humble, down-to-earth, and collaborative.
Shorter cases and a generalist model give broad exposure and early responsibility.
Smaller offices build close community with limited travel.
why_us_angles: Does the fast pace of PE due diligence projects appeal to you?
How do shorter cases and a generalist model fit your learning goals?
Which L.E.K. sector (e.g., consumer, healthcare, tech) matches your background?
prep_tips: Practice a timed written case: about an hour to digest ~30 slides into a short deck.
Drill quantitative market-sizing and due diligence cases.
Paraphrase the question back before structuring.
Show flexibility by updating hypotheses when new data arrives.
